info.name: OpenAI API
info.description:
Bo request chuan cho OpenAI API (base: https://api.openai.com/v1).

Yeu cau: import kem Environment 'OpenAI Environment' va dien bien openai_api_key.

Auth duoc cau hinh o cap Collection (Bearer Token) => moi request con tu ke thua, khong can set header Authorization thu cong.

Header OpenAI-Organization va OpenAI-Project duoc dat o cap Collection nhung mac dinh TAT (disabled). Chi bat khi ban thuoc nhieu org/project.

header.description: Tuy chon. Chi bat khi ban thuoc nhieu organization.
Tuy chon. Chi bat khi can chi dinh project cu the.

request.description:
POST /v1/responses

Field toi thieu: model + input.
'input' chap nhan chuoi don gian, hoac mang item de gui multi-turn / multimodal.

'store': true => response duoc luu lai va co the Retrieve sau. Dat false neu ban chay stateless / ZDR.

De test streaming: them "stream": true (response tra ve dang SSE).

Test script cua request nay tu dong luu field 'id' vao bien environment 'response_id'.

query.description: Tuy chon. So luong item tra ve moi trang.
Tuy chon. Cursor phan trang - id cua item cuoi trang truoc.
[CAN KIEM TRA LAI DOCS] Chua xac minh 100% cac gia tri hop le cua param nay.

request.description:
GET /v1/responses/{response_id}/input_items

Liet ke cac input item da duoc gui kem response.
Cac query param phan trang de disabled - bat khi can.

item.description: Responses API - be mat API duoc OpenAI khuyen nghi cho project moi.

item.name: Chat Completions

exec: // Luu completion id de request Retrieve dung lai ngay

header.description: Tuy chon. Trace id tu sinh phia client, toi da 512 ky tu ASCII. Huu ich khi can doi chieu voi support neu request timeout.

request.description:
POST /v1/chat/completions

Field bat buoc: model + messages.

Luu y: mot so model reasoning khong chap nhan 'temperature' - neu gap loi 400, xoa field do khoi body.

De test streaming: doi "stream": true (response la SSE).

Test script tu dong luu 'id' vao bien 'chat_completion_id'.

query.description: Tuy chon. So luong ban ghi moi trang.
Tuy chon. asc | desc theo thoi diem tao.
[CAN KIEM TRA LAI DOCS] Chua xac minh 100% cu phap truyen metadata filter qua query string.

request.description:
GET /v1/chat/completions

Chi liet ke duoc cac completion da duoc luu lai (store).
Neu tra ve mang rong, kha nang cao la cac request truoc chua bat luu tru.

item.description: Chat Completions API - van duoc ho tro, thich hop khi migrate code cu hoac dung chung interface voi cac provider OpenAI-compatible.

item.name: Models

request.description:
GET /v1/models

Tra ve danh sach model ma API key hien tai co quyen truy cap.
Day la smoke test nhanh nhat de xac nhan key hop le (200 = OK, 401 = key sai).

Khong co query param.

item.description: Kham pha model kha dung cho API key hien tai.

request.description:
POST /v1/embeddings

Field bat buoc: model + input.
'input' chap nhan chuoi don, hoac mang chuoi de batch nhieu doan cung luc.

'encoding_format': float (mac dinh) hoac base64.
Co the them 'dimensions' de rut gon so chieu vector - chi ho tro tren cac model embedding doi moi.

item.name: Moderations

request.description:
POST /v1/moderations

Field bat buoc: input.
'model' de mac dinh 'omni-moderation-latest' - khong dung bien {{model}} vi day la ho model rieng, khong phai model sinh van ban.

Endpoint nay khong tinh phi theo token nhu cac endpoint sinh noi dung.

item.description: Phan loai noi dung co kha nang gay hai.
